turns.message: I ordered an HP Pavilion laptop on Amazon on December 26, 2023 and paid Rs 61,990. It was delivered on December 27, 2023, but it was an obsolete IBM ThinkPad, not what I ordered. I contacted customer care immediately; they asked me to photograph the product and upload the photos, which I did. The item was picked up on January 1, 2024, but no refund came. On January 7, 2024 I got a message that the return was lost in transit. On January 19, 2024 Amazon emailed that it cannot refund me because the returned item is different from what I ordered and my number of refunds exceeds expectations under its Use Policy. I replied that I returned it because it was different from what I ordered.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact purchase and pickup dates, support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.
